lhs: Dense concatenation of the original ordered list of arbitrary compatible source blocks.
rhs: Dense concatenation after the left-to-right scanner replaces maximal touching unit-slice runs by their merged slices.
conditions: Shared arbitrary static prefix/suffix shapes; instruction identity, crop start equality and touching legal unit-stride intervals gate each merge. Noneligible operands are opaque barriers with arbitrary values/widths.
types: Any payload type, Nat indices and lengths, including zero widths and empty output shapes.
overlap: Paper concat/rule04 is the historical two-slice case; slice_merge_run accepts a supplied run on a fixed source/crop. This proof computes the maximal grouping and proves the whole mixed-list result. No separate count for maximality or the historical pair.
